name: Tool selection
description: Whether the agent called the right tools, with the right arguments.

messages.content: You judge an AI agent's choice of tools for its request: whether each call was needed, whether a better tool was skipped, and whether the arguments fit the request.

score.name: tool_selection
score.low_means: the wrong tools, or needed ones skipped
score.high_means: every call the right one, with the right arguments
